main.name: Tobi Oladimeji
main.description: I build reporting, data quality, automation, and decision-support systems using Power BI, SQL, Python, and applied AI. My experience spans consulting, technology, sustainability, grant intelligence, and mission-driven organizations.
bio: I am a data and analytics professional with 5+ years of experience across business intelligence, reporting, data operations, automation, and applied analytics.

My work has included enterprise data migration and reporting at PwC, analytics and machine-learning workflows at ESGTree in Waterloo, and data quality, KPI, and automation systems for a grant-intelligence platform at Granted Technologies.

I work primarily with Power BI, SQL, Python, Excel, data quality frameworks, reporting workflows, and AI-enabled automation. I am particularly interested in turning complex operational data into clear information that helps teams make better decisions.

Outside of my professional analytics work, I founded Data Fellows, a global data and technology ecosystem with 1,500+ members across 15+ countries, and I am building Inscend, a decision-intelligence product focused on helping businesses make better decisions from their data.
I am based in Waterloo Region, Ontario.
main.contactmessage: Let's connect and discuss how I can contribute to your team's analytics, reporting, and decision-support work.

resume.skillmessage: Core analytics, reporting, data, and automation capabilities.

work.title: Strategic Advisor, Data & Operations
work.description: Advise on data architecture, quality controls, workflows, and automation for a grant-intelligence platform. Develop QA frameworks supporting 1,500+ grant records and end-to-end grant discovery, validation, and structured extraction workflows. Define KPIs for data quality, throughput, and team performance; apply AI-assisted data cleaning and operational automation; and translate data quality and operational findings into leadership reporting.

work.title: Data Analyst & Machine Learning Engineer
work.description: Built Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions, supported SQL and Python data pipelines, and collaborated with data engineers on scalable analytics workflows. Developed LLM-based document extraction that reduced manual data input by approximately 30%, working cross-functionally across engineering, operations, and analytics.

work.title: Data Analytics Team Lead
work.description: Supported an enterprise transition from Microsoft Dynamics AX to Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, achieving approximately 98% data accuracy through SQL, Excel, Power BI, data validation, reporting, and transformation. Led 20 stakeholder mapping and requirements sessions, developed 30+ Python scripts, collaborated with 15 stakeholders, and delivered reporting to senior management.

work.title: Founder & Strategy Lead
work.description: Founded and grew a 1,500+ member data and technology ecosystem across 15+ countries. Lead partnerships, learning programs, applied analytics initiatives, and cross-functional teams delivering practical data and AI projects. Incubated Inscend, a decision-intelligence product, through product discovery, data strategy, and applied automation.

work.title: Data Analyst
work.description: Developed 10+ Power BI dashboards and recurring operational reports using SQL and Excel. Delivered Python analytics projects with pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib, and improved database validation and automation processes, contributing to an approximately 25% improvement in data accuracy.

projects.title: M & E Dashboard
projects.description: Monitoring and evaluation dashboard providing visibility into visit status, geographic activity, pending fieldwork, and operational performance.

projects.title: AgroWallet Dashboard
projects.description: Operational reporting on farmer profiles, financial activity, loans, disbursements, repayments, agents, and farm characteristics.

projects.title: Logistics Dashboard
projects.description: Operational dashboard tracking vendors, product movement, transport availability, and logistics status to support day-to-day reporting.

projects.title: Ontario Community Project
projects.description: SQL analysis of Ontario infrastructure data covering project budgets, statuses, completion timelines, and community-level decision support.

projects.title: Library Management System
projects.description: Relational database analysis of books, borrowers, branches, and loan activity to answer practical library operations questions.

projects.title: Tire Price Analysis
projects.description: Python analysis of 4,350 tire records to identify pricing patterns, customer preferences, and actionable business insights for procurement and product decisions.

projects.title: Real-Time Seismic Event Monitoring Solution
projects.description: Real-time public-data ingestion and geospatial analysis solution using USGS data, with automated seismic monitoring and operational reporting.

testimonials.text: It was a great pleasure to have worked with Tobi. He is a very responsible, determined, and hard working profesional. Tobi really helped us in analyzing data and report generation for various clients,developing them in PowerBi and integrating databases. Constantly solved problems and proposed new ideas. Tobi was always a team player and was invested in making things work. Apart from being a great profesional he is a great person.

Tobi's excepcional patience, professionalism, and capability to understand and work with disorganized data sets have turned him into an asset for our team. I admire his capacity to create reports from scratch in Power BI and connect various platforms to turn simple datasets added to a Google Sheets into meaningful reports for making informed decisions. Of course, he is a great coworker, and I can wholeheartedly recommend Tobi without any doubt.

Tobi is an outstanding young professional with so much potential. During our time at PwC, I witnessed his dedication to mastering data analysis. Tobi's ability to tackle complex data challenges and his eagerness to learn set him apart. He's not just a team player but also brings a fresh perspective to every project. I highly recommend Tobi for his skills, passion, and the promise he holds in the field of data analytics
